meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 通过 Dial 平台给 Claude 配一个真实电话号码,可收发短信、接听 AI 语音来电。安装时会复制 Dial 适配器代码、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试,再登录 Dial、注册线路、配对手机。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 拥有可收发短信、接听 AI 语音电话的真实号码,并要求添加 Dial 渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 Claude 加上 Dial 渠道,我要一个能收发短信的号码。
say.note: 会复制适配器、构建,并引导你登录 Dial。

say.text: 把这条 Dial 线路的来电问候语改成:先问好并记录留言。
say.note: 会改写 AI 接听来电时用的系统提示词。

say.text: 这条线只允许我配对的那个手机号发短信。
say.note: 会把线路设为仅 owner 可发消息(strict)。

howto.what_en: Gives Claude a real phone number via Dial, for SMS and AI voice calls. Setup copies the Dial adapter, installs deps, builds, runs the registration test, signs in to Dial, registers the line, and pairs your phone.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Dial channel to Claude — a real phone number that sends and receives SMS and answers AI voice calls.

say_en.text: Add the Dial channel to Claude — I want a number that sends and receives SMS.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter, building, and the Dial sign-in flow.

say_en.text: Change this Dial line's inbound greeting to greet callers and take a message.
say_en.note: Rewrites the system prompt the AI uses on incoming calls.

say_en.text: Only the phone I pair may text this Dial line.
say_en.note: Sets the line's unknown-sender policy to strict.
